name: ayunika-compliance-team
description: Four-agent compliance team for cosmetic launch content. Generates platform-specific copy, rejects rule breaches with rule numbers and quoted evidence, and remediates until each platform passes the human approval gate.

displayDescription.en: Four agents review cosmetic launch copy for TikTok, Instagram and marketplace: plan, draft, then verify against R-01..R-21. Every rejection cites its rule number and quotes the exact offending words, and each draft is rewritten until it passes — with publication still locked behind a human approval key.
displayDescription.zh: 四角色团队生成多平台上市文案并核验合规：违规附规则编号与原文引用，逐稿改到合规，发布由人工持钥把关。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 为 AY-SR-101 生成 TikTok、Instagram 与电商店铺三个平台的上市文案，并逐个核验合规
defaultInitPrompt.en: Generate and verify AY-SR-101 launch copy for TikTok, Instagram and marketplace

quickPrompts.zh: 为 AY-SR-101 生成 TikTok、Instagram 与电商店铺三个平台的上市文案，并逐个核验合规
quickPrompts.en: Generate and verify AY-SR-101 launch copy for TikTok, Instagram and marketplace

quickPrompts.zh: 核验这段文案：列出每条违规的规则编号、原文引用和具体改法
quickPrompts.en: Check this draft: list each violation with its rule number, the quoted words, and a concrete fix

quickPrompts.zh: 列出四个 SKU 及各自的 halal 状态，并说明哪个 boleh diklaim halal
quickPrompts.en: List all four SKUs and their halal status, and say which one may be claimed as halal
